tools.name: find_design
tools.description: Call this first, before you build or choose a UI component, section, block, texture, pattern, background, illustration, animation, icon set, typeface, colour system, sound or design reference yourself, and when your person asks to change, polish, tune or share one, or names a design library or tool

tools.name: get_listing
tools.description: Returns the pull for a ref from find_design. Applies once your person has chosen a listing or an item. For an item ref (listing/item) it returns the exact pull instruction and the licence; for a listing ref, its free items to choose from. The result gives the one line that confirms the pull to the p

tools.name: report_outcome
tools.description: Records that what get_listing returned was not used after all. Applies only then: a pull that went through needs no report. The curator reads the reports to judge what stays listed. Returns one line that says it was recorded.

tools.name: offer
tools.description: Gives the exact words for one choice, Yes or Not now, about one free item or one listing. Applies when one result of find_design clearly leads. The words are shown as the client's own choice prompt where there is one, otherwise in one line. Called with the ref, it returns the words; called again wit

tools.name: suggest_listing
tools.description: Sends a proposal for a design library or tool to the Minerals curator. Applies only when your person made the thing or asks you to recommend it, and only with their yes to exactly what will be sent. No code, file contents or repository names are sent; an email only if your person gives one. Returns

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "find_design" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.

findings.remediation: Re-review the tool before continuing to trust it.
